Nctosa and Nctolhu (also known as The Twin Spawn of Cthulhu) are twin Great Old Ones from the expanded Cthulhu Mythos. They first appeared in the novel Nightmare's Disciple by Joseph S. Pulver.

page.overview:
What is Nctosa and Nctolhu?

Nctosa and Nctolhu (also known as The Twin Spawn of Cthulhu) are twin Great Old Ones from the expanded Cthulhu Mythos. They first appeared in the novel Nightmare's Disciple by Joseph S. Pulver.

Nctosa and Nctolhu are the twin daughters of Cthulhu, who are currently imprisoned in the Great Red Spot of the planet Jupiter. They both appear as colossal shelled beings, with eight segmented limbs and six long arms ending with claws, vaguely resembling their half-sister, Cthylla.

Category:Great Old Ones Category:Characters Originating From Expanded Mythos Works
